title: Anastomosis
html_source:
Anastomosis is an apt term meaning a cross-connection of two channels, passages, or vessels.

Interestingly, Joyce himself apparently gave it an additional, linguistic definition: the insertion of one word within another, as in “underdarkneath” (see link).
